name: Prempeh I
contribution: The 13th King of the Ashanti Empire and the Oyoko Abohyen Dynasty.

checks.lead: Prempeh I (Otumfuo Nana Prempeh I; 18 December 1870 – 12 May 1931) was the 13th King of the Ashanti Empire and the Oyoko Abohyen Dynasty. King Prempeh I ruled from March 26, 1888 until his death in 1931, and fought an Ashanti war against Britain in 1895-1896.
